verses.text: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous people! Praise belongs on the lips of those who live uprightly.
Thank the LORD with the lyre. Sing praise to him with a ten-stringed harp.
Sing him a new song. Play it well and shout for joy!
The LORD’s word is right, and he’s faithful in everything he does.
He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the LORD’s faithful love.
The heavens came into being by the LORD’s word, and all their hosts by the breath of his mouth.
He gathers the sea into a heap and stores the deep waters away.
Let the whole earth fear the LORD. Let everyone who lives in the world stand in awe of him.
He spoke and it came to be. He gave the command and it stood firm.
The LORD brings the nations’ plans to nothing and stops the peoples’ schemes from succeeding.
The LORD’s plans stand firm forever. What he intends lasts through every generation.
Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people he chose as his inheritance.
The LORD looks down from heaven and sees all humanity.
From where he lives, he watches everyone on earth.
He’s the one who formed all their hearts, and he takes notice of everything they do.
A huge army can’t save a king, and great strength can’t rescue a warrior.
A horse is a false hope for safety. All its power can’t save anyone.
The LORD watches over those who fear him and put their hope in his faithful love,
to rescue them from death and keep them alive through famine.
We wait for the LORD with our whole being. He’s our help and our shield.
Our hearts rejoice in him because we trust in his holy name.
Let your faithful love rest on us, LORD, as we put our hope in you.
